#10329 1 2006-07-29T17:02:43Z AMomentLikeThis
Okay, I'm new to this forum, so forgive me if this is the wrong place to put this. I don't like using forums too much, thus why I never made an account before this.

I would like you to see this, as I do not want a bad rep on Numa created from a newcommers accusitions.

LikeNike99 has been accusing me, for the last week or so, of sniping his maps. It all began when I commented on one of his maps saying something along the lines of:

"Can you please stop advertising your maps on other peoples maps, especially without rating them yourself".

Thereafter, he made a string of accusitions towards me apparently sniping his maps.

Earlier today, he submitted a map, which had a description saying "Resubmitted as it was 4.5 but is now 3".

I replied saying, "You really shouldn't let ratings bother you, I cirtainly do not think it deserves 4.5, 3.5 as the gameplay could be better".

Later on he posted this on one of my maps (this):

Quote: LikeNike99
nice map 4.5
btw have you been giving me bad ratings for my maps(not accusing)

I, quite annoyed at this, replied on one of his maps:

Quote: AMomentLikeThis
I only rate maps what I think they deserve, if I don't like a map I usually don't rate it or give some advice

---

Now a little while ago I decide to check Numa (finding that one of my recent tilesets has a 0 with 1 vote), and this map:

http://numa.notdot.net/map/53570

I will write all of this out, as whenever I seem to comment on any of his maps he deletes them.

The description of his map 53570 (entitled "my last map"):

Quote: LikeNike99
the map is dum for a reason. i have proff that

amomentlikethis is sniping my maps
because of this i deleted all my maps
everysingle 1 of my 4.5 maps wer turned into a 3 or 3.5 by him ]2and maybe his mates

I, really annoyed by this accusition, replied:

Quote: AMomentLikeThis
lmao

You're accusing me of sniping?

Fyi, I only rated two of your maps...

(what was said above in this forum post was said here)

...And secondly, I don't know anyone else who's even heard of N. So before you start accusing ME of doing these things, think to yourself, why are MY maps also 0'd or given low votes occasionally? Or are your maps REALLY worth high votes.
Quote: AMomentLikeThis
Oh, and also

I have replied to your posts so many times, but every time you delete the map?

Is this just some form of 'revenge' as I told you to stop advertising your maps?

--

I'm sorry for having to post this, but I seemingly had no choice. Those who might know me on Numa will know that I rarely rate maps below 4, and most of the maps I play are favourited.

I needed to post this so as not to create a bad rep for myself through these accusitions by a newcommer to Numa.

Thank you for reading, and I hope you don't think I'm a liar, if so then I guess my place is obviously not on Numa.

-AMomentLikeThis

Quote: stepself, September 12, 2006 09:12 pm
Hmm. (2x - 11) = (4x - 44x + 121)
So your final equation is wrong. The correct equation is

2x - 11x - 4x + 44x - 121 = 12
-2x + 33x - 133 = 0
2x - 33x + 133 = 0

Use the quadratic formula to solve:

where a = 2, b = -33, and c = 133

You'll get these roots:

x = 7 and 9.5

Now just backsubstitute for both solutions, and you're done. You'll have two sets of coordinates because the linear equation intersects the other one twice.

Emo is a slang term used to describe a range of fashion styles and attitudes somewhat affiliated with emo music and its related scenes. As an adjective, emo can describe a style of fashion or music; or a general state of unhappiness or melancholy (as in "to feel emo"). Emo is also used as a noun, often pejoratively, to identify a member of the "emo scene" or someone viewed as fitting the "emo" stereotype.

The goth subculture has associated gothic tastes in music and fashion. Gothic music encompasses a number of different styles. Common to all is a tendency towards a dark sound and outlook. Styles of dress within the subculture range from death rock, punk, Victorian, androgynous, some Renaissance style clothes, or combinations of the above, most often with black attire, makeup and hair.

#240553 2 2006-10-13T17:32:05Z AMomentLikeThis
You should have a text document named "userlevels", located in the same folder as the game.



In that document it clearly says:




Quote
*********************************************************************************************

*** INSTRUCTIONS ****************************************************************************



This file contains data used to fill the [User Levels] menu in N;

editing the contents of this file allows you to alter the contents of the in-game menu.

We recommend that you turn Word Wrap off to edit this file.





It's _very_ important that you format data properly when adding it to this file,

or who knows what will happen. Wait, I know: something bad.





To add a level to the list, simply add it into this file using the following syntax:



$levelname#authorname#comments#leveldata#



(it's _very_ important that you don't forget the final "#" after the level data!!)



The fields should be self-explanitory:

	levelname: the name of the level, i.e "superliminal"

	authorname: the name of the person who made the level, i.e "jimmy"

	comments: you can use this field to describe the level type, i.e "easy", "hard", "boring", etc.

	leveldata: data describing the level, usually taken from the level editor





Level and author names which contain "#" will produce errors.

You can add text between level data as long as it doesn't contain "$" or "#" characters. This is helpful

for separating levels within this file, as you can see below.





If you're a bit confused, please browse the included level data; it will hopefully provide you

with some insight as to what needs to be done in order to add/remove user levels. 



Obviously, renaming or moving this file will result in problems. 







To get more user levels, please visit NUMA: http://numa.notdot.net 





*********************************************************************************************

IMPORTANT: changing the following line in any way will screw everything up. Don't do it!!



&userdata=

*** ALL LEVEL DATA MUST BE ENTERED BELOW THIS LINE ******************************************














If you don't have the folder at all, redownload N and continue from there. It should be quite simple.



Edit: Oh, and if copying from Numa, make sure you copy the box with #[level name]#[username] etc., the other box is used in debug mode.

--

The rest, ~8500, are unrecorded immigrants.



--



A while ago, some (about 8) WHITE soldiers came back to England from fighting the Taliban in Afghanistan. They put their money together to rent a fairly large house in a pleasant area called Datchet.

Muslims found out about this house, located about a mile or so from Windsor Castle (and yes, they were MUSLIM, I'm not generalizing or anything, I'm being factual). They spray painted in large letters on this houses drive "Fuck off", they broke ALL the windows, and used phone-threats against the soldiers. 



Our soldiers can't return without "inflaming racial tensions".



--



In my school, Slough Grammar School, I'm the only white person in my physics group. They talk in their own languages and often mock me in these languages, which is just cowardly.



--



A few weeks ago, a high powered political man (forgive me, I'm not that good with politics), in England said that he asks Muslims to remove their veils before he can talk to them, as he finds it intimidating.



The press and the government frowned upon this.



He then expressed that he would prefer it if Muslims didn't wear the veil at all as it is impossible to see what they're thinking etc..



I'm supprised he wasn't forced to resign after all the negativity he recieved. I FULLY AGREE WITH HIM.



--



Either yesterday or today, a Christian flight attendant for British Airways was told to "go home" for wearing a necklass with a cross on it, as it was "not part of the uniform".



MUSLIMS DON'T NEED TO REMOVE THEIR VEILS WHEN THEY'RE IN UNIFORM, YET THEY ARE OPTIONAL RELIGIOUS THINGS. SURELY A CROSS IS AN OPTIONAL RELIGIOUS THING?



--



There are many, MANY more things I could go into. But I don't want this topic to be locked/closed etc..



The point of this is that I need to let out my opinion on things.



I'm not being racist at all. But I believe Muslims should be thoroughly removed from this country. They practically run us. If we do ANYTHING against them, its "racist". If they do anything to us, they can basicly get away with it.



If we were to go to their countries and protest etc.. We would probably be killed.

Yet they do it here.



Fuck all people who call themselves "British Asians", theres no such thing.

I'm sorry if this offends anyone, but things need to change.



POLITICAL CORRECTNESS IS A LOAD OF SHIT.



I TOTALLY AGREE WITH BNP POLICIES.

#344464 30 2007-07-18T11:40:23Z AMomentLikeThis
Quote: Tsukatu, July 17, 2007 11:13 pm
 
Quote: AMomentLikeThis, July 17, 2007 04:55 pm
 I could never imagine falling 'in love' with one of the characters. Falling 'in love' with a cartoon character is lust more than anything. 
I really don't think so.



Humans fall in love because they want to be in a certain person's company, including in her romantic company. Meeting in person is not actually a requirement. In many cases, that can be an unhealthy sort of love, but it could just as easily be extended to someone you meet through business in which neither of you physically appear before one another. It's also easily possible to fall in love with someone whom you've not only ever met but probably never will meet, such as a celebrity. As long as you know enough about the person's life, behavior, character, etc., you can't really call that love unhealthy.

When you're talking about anime characters, you're simply guaranteed to never personally interact with her. But an anime can show you a great deal about that fictional character's personality, and so falling in love with an anime character is little different from falling in love with someone you'll never meet - it's still love in the truest sense of the word.



Hell, you don't even have to see someone to fall in love. Many people don't care in the slightest about looks, or are satisfied with a description. I bet you plenty of people have fallen in love with characters they've read about in a book, of whom any sort of illustrations have never been made.  
 

 I agree with what you're saying, I actually dislike using the word lust, but I think its more lust than love in this case. Even the longing to meet someone actually like the portrayed character, maybe. 

Love can easily occur from a book or story as you're made to picture the person you're reading about, and in a way you picture a somewhat perfect person. In anime you see what each character looks like. Sure you can find them very attractive, or have amazing personalities, but I'd still say that that is lust more than love.




Quote: Tsukatu, 2007-07-17T23:13:29Z
But what bothers me a little more is that you say that anime characters can't present any traits other than their appearance. Unless you're looking at static images and not seeing that character interact with her world in the slightest, then yeah, it'd be lust (yet also in the truest sense of the word). But when you're looking at, as you say it, a "cartoon character," you actually get less from the appearance, and your knowledge of that character's behavior and personality is much larger in proportion, compared to what you would know if the character's appearance was more realistic. It is far more shallow to be in lust with an anime character than it is to be in lust with a human, because you know even less
I cirtainly wasn't saying that the characters cannot present any traits other than appearance, I was more trying to imply that "love" in k2y9d4o1's case is more lust, or wanting to live in the world that his 'perfect' anime character lives in.

I was just messing around with NaN'd launch pads a few minutes ago, and found that if you NaN the number before the last one (ie: '2^360,480,NaN,-1'), and kill your ninja by pressing Enter, if you respawn the ninja and make him hit the NaN'd launch pad, he will be frozen in place where he was just before he was respawned.



Eg: Try this level. Kill the ninja, respawn, then hit the launch pad.



http://www.pastebin.ca/raw/653518

Week Two



For Why Must It Be So Shiney?, by Maximo, you have to collect any 4 gold.



A little note for future reference: If you collect more gold than the competition requires of you, 3 seconds will be deducted off of your time per extra gold piece.



--



About



Every week players will compete against each other in trying to get the fastest possible no-gold demos on a set three maps posted here every Wednesday. Each player has a week in which to perfect their no-gold runs, and submit their demos to me via Personal Message on the forum. Any demos received after 11:59PM (GMT) Tuesday will be ignored. 



The fastest three demos I receive for each map will be put here, and the creators of each demo will get a score; 1st place gets 3 points, 2nd gets 2 points, and 3rd gets 1 point. The highest possible score you can receive in a single week is 9 points (excluding improvements).

Improvements on existing demos can get you up to 3 points. If the fastest demo on a map was 86.875, and you improved it by 0.025-0.050, you would receive 1 point, if you improved it by 0.075-0.100 you would receive 2 points, and if you improved it by 0.125 or more you would receive the maximum 3 points. You can not submit improvements to your own demos.



--



Rules
  • Please only submit userlevel-friendly demos. Either copy the demo straight from your userlevels, or put the map data before the demo data (without spaces). Any non-userlevels friendly demos will be ignored.
  • Only submit honest demos - Speed-hacking, fbfing, demo editing, and any other forms of cheating demos are strictly forbidden. If I believe you are found to be cheating, you will be removed from the competition, your score and all previous demos received from you will be removed.
  • Copying someone elses demo is forbidden. A submitted demo must be your own. This is why I want the demos PM'd to me, rather than letting everyone see them.
